name: EmailLink
description: a mailto hyperlink for an email address
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `aria-label="..."` -- optional override for the accessible name when the visible email text alone is insufficient context
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `email`: string (required) -- the email address to display and link to
`label`: string (default: `undefined`) -- optional accessible label override via `aria-label`
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the `<a>` element
